payload.answer: Execute Front 1 (the test/CI loop) of docs/runbooks/expansion/13-cost-performance.md: (1) per-worker test databases via the PostgreSQL template-database pattern so suites never contend on vibey_test, (2) pytest-xdist parallelism (-n auto) across the whole suite, (3) a single full-coverage run that enforces all four per-layer 100 percent branch floors from one .coverage file instead of four sequential suite runs, (4) a commit-hook diet: hook runs changed-file lints plus the single parallel suite once; the pre-push/CI stage owns the full sweep. Read the runbook file first - it is the spec.
